answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops clone farms. A new identity posts 40 units and climbs to the summit over 10 epochs as the network records its work fingerprint. It unlocks only if the fingerprint fits its role and matches no other. A grove of clones whispering one script shares a single fingerprint, so the cluster stays locked. 1,000 clones cost 40,000 units against a 50-unit reward; one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its full share.
